utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that repair drive, Dane. Tell me what still needs doing and I’ll see what I can take on.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m just joining now, but I can take the rest if you tell me what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I just joined, so tell me what’s left and I’ll take the rest.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take a look if you send the details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — send the details and I’ll check them carefully.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Send the repair details and I’ll check them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a few spare tarps and a box of screws I can bring over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That’d be a huge help, thanks. I’ll have the repair drive ready when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll head over with them now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you tell me what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I need to know the exact repairs first, and whether we can get the parts today.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: If you can list the exact repairs, I can check whether the parts are available today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I mostly need the latest update on what still needs fixing and who’s handling it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I need the current list of fixes and who’s on each one.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s getting a good turnout. Folks around here usually show up when there’s work that actually matters.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, that’s the part I like. If folks need a hand, I’ve got tools and I’m happy to lend them out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s Gus for you, always ready with a wrench when somebody needs one.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You should come by the repair drive later - we could use another pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure, I can stop by and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, see you there. I’ll let the others know you’re coming.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that. What’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What’s left exactly?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Just the big stuff: drywall patching, the loose hinge by the back door, and that broken outlet cover.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Bo. I’ve got the repair drive list organized, and I’ll keep track of who still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll check the list and see where I can help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks, Bo. I’ll keep the list updated as you go so we can cover everyone who still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m on it — I’ll pass the repair drive plan along to the others.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. Keep it simple and tell them what needs fixing and when you can start.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll tell them what needs fixing and when I can start.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive. I think I was meaning to check on that, but I might be mixing up the details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, it’s the repair drive. I’m not sure of all the details either, but I wanted to make sure it still happens.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I want to make sure it still happens too. I’ll check what I can and we can sort out the details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that repair drive. What part still needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly the wiring by the front steps. I can show you after I finish these errands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That works. I can meet you there after your errands and take a look at the wiring by the front steps.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Dane, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive now, so count me in if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll probably show up a bit late, but I can still help once I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll keep an eye out for you, and I’ll let folks know you’re on your way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. What’s the first thing you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Start with the tools. If you can bring me the screwdriver and the repair list, I can sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll bring the screwdriver and the repair list right over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after I check the school pickup window and see what kind of repair drive timing works.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds good, Faye. Let me know the timing, and I’ll line up the repair drive around it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I should know the pickup window by this afternoon, and then I can confirm a repair drive time that fits.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word and connect folks if you need an extra hand with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be great, Jules. I’ll keep you posted on what still needs fixing so you can help get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, just keep me in the loop and I’ll help get the word out wherever it’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand with that. What needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to keep the pieces organized - what exactly needs fixing, and how many houses are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m thinking the first pass is one or two houses, just the ones with the most urgent fixes, and I can help sort the parts by house as we go.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of who has what and where. Tell me the location and I’ll remember it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks. I’ll jot down the locations as you send them, and we’ll keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, send me the first item and I’ll keep track of its location.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the repair drive start, and where should I bring the donations?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I have the details right before I tell you, so let me check the start time and drop-off spot first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it, just let me know when you have the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that. Tell me what the repair drive needs most, and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We need tools, mostly screws, and maybe a drill battery if you've got one.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring screws, and I’ll check whether I have a drill battery to add.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard a little about the repair drive, but I’m still catching up. Is there anything I should know before I jump in?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Mostly just that it’s a bit loose right now, so if you jump in, start with the list and you should be fine.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll start with the list and keep an eye out for anything else I should know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this is the repair drive you meant?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, that’s the one. I heard they’re starting at the community hall this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, I’ll head over then.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is getting a lot of support. I can swing by after errands if you need another hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I might take you up on that if I get stuck.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Glad to hear it. I’ll be around after errands, so just give me a shout if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Leo, I might’ve mixed up the details, but I’m still in for the repair drive. Just point me where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Meet me at the curb by the blue van, and I’ll show you what needs lifting.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, I’ll be there at the curb by the blue van.
